Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Scientist position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show the following required qualifications: knowledge of probability theory and statistics, understanding of Bayesian methods or time series analysis, hands-on experience with probabilistic programming (Pyro, PyMC3, etc.), experience with Amazon SageMaker, or experience with PySpark.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
